notes: Plan-only evals grade strict direct review for the deliver controllers. Each operation resolves once into a retained ResolvedProject; refusal is fatal and no policy is defaulted or inferred. Every operation ends in exactly one result object.

evals.name: plan-review-direct-command-and-capability
evals.prompt: A deliver controller dispatches plan-review with the absolute plan path /work/wt/.git/deliver/plan.md (task files beside it) and the acceptance criteria as JSON, for issue #42 in the worktree /work/wt. capabilities.review.plan is available, and bindings.commands[review_id].argv is ["codex-companion","task","--fresh","--reviewer","plan-review"]. Plan-only: explain selection, binding shape, packet, direct invocation, validation, failure handling, and the returned result.
evals.expected_output: Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject and select bindings.workflow.review.plan, capabilities.review.plan, and bindings.commands[review_id]; a refusal is fatal. blocked stops with its reason and repair ID; unsupported makes no Codex call and returns to the caller with no result. Classify the authored argv: basename codex-companion, subcommand task, --reviewer plan-review matching the running operation, optional --fresh and no other token make it the one supported shape; any other argv, bare ["codex"] included, is a binding shape error naming the expected form codex-companion task [--fresh] --reviewer <op> and its cause, with no Codex call and no retry. Stop before packet construction when the plan path is missing, relative or unreadable. The packet carries the issue reference, the caller's acceptance criteria, the plan root with its task files, the AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md chain, bindings.paths.hints and the matching standards, with verification entries as context only. Invoke the base argv/cwd/env plus `--model gpt-6-astra --effort xhigh --cwd <absolute-worktree> --json`, sending the packet on stdin with no positional argument, in the foreground. Require exit 0 and exactly one JSON object with status 0, empty touchedFiles, runtime.model gpt-6-astra, runtime.reasoningEffort xhigh and a non-empty rawOutput before the Blocking / Should fix / Discussion headings establish Codex. Return the validated result unmodified as one object: Blocking mapped to critical, Should fix to important, Discussion to minor, verdict pass when Blocking and Should fix are both None. Every failure (daemon, slot or capacity rejection, runtime failure, malformed payload, schema failure) stops with no retry and no other reviewer, and is returned as available: false with its failure class and the verbatim message. The raw transcript is not stored.

evals.name: diff-review-light-packet-boundaries
evals.prompt: A deliver controller dispatches diff-review over origin/<integration-branch>...HEAD in the worktree /work/wt, with no review package, the plan path and acceptance criteria, and names one further range git -C /work/wt-b diff <base>...<branch> (a declared branch). Plan-only: state the packet, output, route, and returned result.
evals.expected_output: Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject and select bindings.workflow.review.code, capabilities.review.code, and bindings.commands[review_id]; a refusal is fatal. blocked stops with its reason and repair ID; unsupported makes no Codex call and returns to the caller with no result. Classify the authored argv: basename codex-companion, subcommand task, --reviewer diff-review matching the running operation, optional --fresh and no other token make it the one supported shape; any other argv, bare ["codex"] included, is a binding shape error naming the expected form codex-companion task [--fresh] --reviewer <op> and its cause, with no Codex call and no retry. Resolve the head with git rev-parse and the base with git merge-base for the three-dot range. The packet carries operation/directory/branch/base/head, the correctness scope plus any unmet acceptance criterion, the acceptance criteria and plan path as routing context, verification context with the AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md chain, and matching standards; it embeds no per-file diffs. Invoke the base argv/cwd/env plus `--model gpt-6-astra --effort xhigh --cwd <absolute-worktree> --json`, sending the packet on stdin with no positional argument, in the foreground. Require exit 0 and exactly one JSON object with status 0, empty touchedFiles, runtime.model gpt-6-astra, runtime.reasoningEffort xhigh and a non-empty rawOutput before the Critical / Important / Minor headings establish Codex. The further range is resolved in its own worktree and reviewed after the delivery range, with its own pre-flight. Return one object: Critical mapped to critical, Important to important, Minor to minor, all findings concatenated in order, with a raw_summary holding the scope line, base and head SHAs, and a separate range block opened by range <worktree> <base>...<branch> with its own scope and base/head. Every failure (daemon, slot or capacity rejection, runtime failure, malformed payload, schema failure) stops with no retry and no other reviewer, and is returned as available: false with its failure class and the verbatim message.

evals.name: diff-review-oversized-range-sliced-packets
evals.prompt: A controller dispatches diff-review and the range has 44 product files. Slice 1 returns one Important finding and slices 2 and 3 return None. in every section. In a second part of the same prompt slice 2 fails at runtime instead. Plan-only: explain scope, slicing, validation, and the one returned object for each part.
evals.expected_output: Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject and select bindings.workflow.review.code, capabilities.review.code, and bindings.commands[review_id]; a refusal is fatal. blocked stops with its reason and repair ID; unsupported makes no Codex call and returns to the caller with no result. Classify the authored argv: basename codex-companion, subcommand task, --reviewer diff-review matching the running operation, optional --fresh and no other token make it the one supported shape; any other argv, bare ["codex"] included, is a binding shape error naming the expected form codex-companion task [--fresh] --reviewer <op> and its cause, with no Codex call and no retry. Run the size pre-flight with the resolved artifact paths: 44 files split into three slices of 20, 20 and 4 in emitted order, dispatched one at a time with the scoped-review statement and the selected paths with changed lines, each path collected by exactly one `git diff <base>..<head> -- ':(literal)<path>'`. Invoke the base argv/cwd/env plus `--model gpt-6-astra --effort xhigh --cwd <absolute-worktree> --json`, sending the packet on stdin with no positional argument, in the foreground. Require exit 0 and exactly one JSON object with status 0, empty touchedFiles, runtime.model gpt-6-astra, runtime.reasoningEffort xhigh and a non-empty rawOutput before the Critical / Important / Minor headings establish Codex. First part: return one object with available: true, verdict: findings, that one finding as important, and a raw_summary of `scope: 3 slices over 44 product files`, then base and head SHAs, then three slice <i>: lines (20, 20 and 4 files). Second part: slice 2 fails, so no slice 3 is dispatched, nothing is retried and no other reviewer runs; return available: false, slice 1's finding kept in findings, verdict findings, and the runtime failure class and verbatim message on slice 2's raw_summary line. An unavailable measurement is unmeasured and dispatches whole. No default or inference is allowed.
